title: 家庭与儿童：陪伴、独立与一起安排生活
intro: 先认识陪伴与照料、家庭分工、独立与支持、选择与界限、代际沟通，再读四段具体生活，理解家人怎样一起安排时间、承担责任和保持联系。
lesson_md:
### 先认识家庭生活中的几个方面

谈家庭与儿童时，内容常常落在几件很具体的事情上：谁接送、做饭和陪孩子；工作日与周末怎样分配时间；哪些事情由孩子自己完成；家人对活动、作息和花钱有不同想法时怎样商量；住得远的亲人又怎样保持联系。认识这些内容以后，就能把“家人对我很好”“照顾孩子很辛苦”说成别人听得明白的生活细节。

**陪伴和照料有关，但不是同一件事。** 照料是把实际需要落实，例如准备一顿饭、接孩子放学、确认生病时由谁陪着。陪伴还包括一起做事、分享近况和留心对方的感受。一个人可能做了很多家务，却没有多少时间聊天；一次短暂散步，也可以给家人认真相处的机会。英语里的 look after 常说实际照料，spend time with 强调与某人相处，pay attention to 强调把注意力放在对方说的话或遇到的事情上。

**家庭分工不仅是“帮忙”，还包括把事情持续负责起来。** household chores 是洗碗、洗衣、摆餐具等日常家务；childcare 则着重于照看孩子。二者有时同时发生，但接孩子回家、陪他待到家长下班，不能只用“做家务”概括。临时帮一次和每天固定负责也不同：谁周一接送、谁检查活动结束时间、临时有事时谁通知学校，都需要讲清楚。祖父母或其他亲人也有自己的工作、休息和生活安排，能否帮忙需要商量。

**独立是能逐步处理一些事情，不是从此不再需要别人。** 孩子可以先学会整理书包、选择衣服或准备一种简单食物。任务是否合适，要看他已经会什么、还需要怎样的帮助。父母提供清单或做一次示范，并不等于替孩子完成所有步骤。on one's own 可以说“不靠别人完成”，take responsibility for 则多了一层“知道这是自己需要负责的事”；忘带东西以后想办法检查，也是承担责任的一部分。

**给选择和设界限可以同时发生。** 家庭里的选择往往有具体条件：活动是否在预算内，结束时有没有人来接，是否还留有吃饭和休息的时间。成人可以先确定可行范围，再让孩子在两个活动或两个时段中选择。孩子喜欢某项活动，是需要听见的个人偏好；那项活动能否落实，还要核对时间、交通和费用。把这两层分开，就能解释为什么一个选择很吸引人，却暂时不适合这个家庭。

**代际沟通既涉及不同经历，也涉及沟通方式。** 年龄不同的家人可能对花钱、工作或休闲有不同看法；有分歧不一定意味着关系不好。有人喜欢当面说，有人习惯发文字，也有人读小字不方便。get along with 描述相处情况，keep in touch 描述是否持续联系，have something in common 则说明两人共有的兴趣或经历。共同做饭、谈园艺、分享一张旧照片，都能成为谈话内容，而不只是不断问“最近忙不忙”。

下面四段生活分别把这些内容放进日常陪伴、家务独立、祖孙联系和课后安排中。它们也说明，同一个家庭往往需要同时顾及感受、责任和实际时间。

### 情境一：一天里真正相处的那一小段时间

On weekdays, Lena's mother often gets home just before dinner. She would like to spend more time with her daughter, but there are still dishes to wash and clothes to put away. They have started taking a short walk after dinner instead of saving every conversation for the weekend. During the walk, they take turns talking about one good thing and one difficult thing from their day. One evening, Lena explains that she felt left out when her friends chose teams at school. Her mother puts her phone away and listens before offering advice. They do not solve everything on the walk, but Lena has time to finish her story. Later, they catch up with Lena's father while making tea together.

#### 把内容读明白

Lena 的妈妈平日快到晚饭时间才回家，吃完饭仍有碗碟和衣物要处理。她们没有等到周末才认真聊天，而是把饭后散步变成一起相处的时间：两人轮流说当天一件开心的事和一件不顺的事。有一天，Lena 说到学校分组时被朋友冷落。妈妈先把手机收起来，让她把经过讲完，然后才给建议。这里的陪伴不是安排昂贵活动，也不是一听见困难就立刻替孩子解决；它具体表现为留出一段时间、认真听清一件事情。最后一家人泡茶时又聊起近况，谈话自然接进了日常家务。

#### 两处值得留下的表达

**1. She would like to spend more time with her daughter, but there are still dishes to wash and clothes to put away.**

spend time with someone 是“花时间和某人在一起”。with 后接人；如果说做什么事情，用 spend time doing something，例如 We spend half an hour cooking together. 后半句的 dishes to wash 指“还需要洗的碗碟”，把时间不够的原因说得具体。

**2. During the walk, they take turns talking about one good thing and one difficult thing from their day.**

take turns doing something 表示“轮流做某事”，这里不是妈妈一直问、孩子一直答，而是双方都分享。可以换成 We take turns choosing a film. 如果明确“轮到谁”，则说 It is my turn to choose. 不要写成 take turns to talking。

### 情境二：学会做家务，也学会收拾自己的疏漏

Eleven-year-old Sam wants his parents to let him do more things on his own. His father suggests starting with two daily tasks: setting the table and packing his schoolbag. At first, Sam forgets his sports shoes, and his father has to remind him to check the next day's timetable. Together, they put a short checklist beside the front door. Sam also chooses one simple lunch he can prepare without help. His first sandwich falls apart because he puts too much filling inside, so they try again with less. His parents do not expect everything to be perfect. They want him to take responsibility for a few regular tasks, notice what went wrong, and ask for help when he needs it.

#### 把内容读明白

Sam 想获得更多自己做事的机会，爸爸没有一下把所有事情都交给他，而是先约定摆餐具和整理书包这两项日常任务。忘带运动鞋以后，父子一起把检查清单放到门边，提醒自己查看第二天的课表。Sam 做午饭时把三明治夹得太满，结果散开；这次疏漏通过少放一些馅料来调整。独立在这个家庭里并不等于“大人永远不提醒”或“孩子从不求助”，而是逐渐把某件事从头到尾负责起来：知道要做什么、做完检查，遇到不会的部分再问。

#### 两处值得留下的表达

**1. His father suggests starting with two daily tasks: setting the table and packing his schoolbag.**

suggest 后面可以直接接 -ing 形式：suggest starting，不能说 suggest to start。daily tasks 包括家务和个人准备：摆餐具是 household chore，整理书包则是自己的上学准备。set the table 指摆放吃饭要用的餐具，不是把桌子搬到某处。

**2. They want him to take responsibility for a few regular tasks, notice what went wrong, and ask for help when he needs it.**

take responsibility for 后接名词或 -ing 形式，表示把某项事情负责起来，例如 take responsibility for feeding the cat。这里接着列出检查问题和求助，说明“负责”包括采取行动，并不要求一个人什么都会。want him to 后面三个动作 take、notice、ask 形式保持一致。

### 情境三：不同年龄的人，怎样把话说到一起

When Amir moves to another city, he sends his grandfather photos and short messages almost every day. His grandfather rarely replies, so Amir begins to think that he is not interested. During a visit, Amir discovers that the small text on the phone is difficult for his grandfather to read. They work out a different way to keep in touch: voice messages during the week and a call on Sunday afternoon. Their conversations become easier when Amir asks about the garden, something they both enjoy. They do not agree about every choice Amir makes, especially how he spends his money. Still, they get along well because they explain their reasons and give each other time to respond, rather than treating every difference as an argument.

#### 把内容读明白

Amir 搬到别的城市后经常发照片和文字，却很少收到爷爷的回复。他最初把“没有回复”理解成“不感兴趣”，见面以后才发现手机上的小字让爷爷读起来费力。两人于是商量出更合适的联系办法：平日发语音，周日下午通话。园艺是两人共有的兴趣，能让聊天不只是问“最近怎么样”。他们对花钱的看法仍然不同，但关系好不要求每一件事都意见一致。这个情境中，先了解对方遇到的实际困难、找到共同话题，再解释各自的理由，比根据回复次数猜测感情更有帮助。

#### 两处值得留下的表达

**1. They work out a different way to keep in touch: voice messages during the week and a call on Sunday afternoon.**

work out 在这里是“想出、商定一个办法”，不是“锻炼”。keep in touch 表示保持联系，接联系对象时用 with：I keep in touch with my grandfather. 冒号后给出了联系的方式和时间，让“常联系”成为具体安排。

**2. Still, they get along well because they explain their reasons and give each other time to respond, rather than treating every difference as an argument.**

get along well with someone 表示“与某人相处融洽”，不等于总是赞同对方。rather than 后接 treating，与前面的做法形成对照：不是把每个差异都当作争吵。every difference 指每一次看法上的不同，比笼统说“代沟很大”更清楚。

### 情境四：喜欢的课后活动，还需要可行的接送安排

Nora's school finishes at half past three, but her parents usually work until five. On Mondays, her aunt picks her up and takes her home. On Tuesdays and Thursdays, Nora attends an after-school club, where she has a snack and plays board games with other children. She would like to join a dance class too, but it ends before either parent can collect her. The family checks the timetable and finds a Saturday class instead. Her father can drop her off on his way to the shops. They also agree what to do if an adult is delayed: contact the school office and tell Nora who is coming. The arrangements need to fit around working hours while leaving Nora some quiet time at home.

#### 把内容读明白

Nora 三点半放学，父母通常五点才下班，所以不同日子需要不同安排：周一姨妈接她回家，周二和周四参加校内课后活动。她想学舞蹈，但原先那节课结束得太早，父母都赶不上接；查看课表后，一家人改选周六的班，爸爸可以顺路送她。除了正常安排，他们还商量了大人迟到时怎样通知学校、怎样告诉 Nora 来接她的是谁。这里要同时考虑活动内容、接送时间、联系人和孩子在家休息的时间。“有一门课可报名”与“这个家庭实际参加得了”是两回事。

#### 两处值得留下的表达

**1. Her father can drop her off on his way to the shops.**

drop someone off 是“把某人送到某处后离开”；代词必须放在中间：drop her off，不能写 drop off her。on his way to the shops 表示“去商店的路上”，自然说明爸爸为什么方便送她。

**2. The arrangements need to fit around working hours while leaving Nora some quiet time at home.**

fit around working hours 是让安排与工作时间相协调，不是让工作去配合活动。while leaving... 还补了一项同时要顾及的需要。可以套用为 The lessons fit around my work schedule. 

### 16 个日常能用上的词与搭配

| 词与搭配 | 意思与常用结构 | 自然例句 |
|---|---|---|
| spend time with | 花时间和某人在一起；spend time with someone | I spend time with my daughter while we water the plants. |
| catch up | 聊聊近况；了解彼此最近的生活；catch up with someone | We catch up with each other over dinner on Fridays. |
| take turns | 轮流做某事；take turns doing something | The children take turns choosing a game for the family to play. |
| pay attention to | 注意；认真关注；pay attention to what someone says | When my son explains a problem, I try to pay attention to what he says. |
| household chores | 家务；家中日常需要做的事情；share the household chores | We share the household chores so that one person does not have to do everything. |
| on one's own | 独自；不依靠他人帮助，具体意思由情境决定；do something on your own | Sam packed his schoolbag on his own this morning. |
| take responsibility for | 负责；承担某件事的责任；take responsibility for a task | My brother takes responsibility for feeding the cat before school. |
| remind somebody to | 提醒某人去做某事；remind someone to do something | Please remind me to put the permission form in her schoolbag. |
| get along with | 与某人相处；关系融洽；get along well with someone | I get along well with my grandfather, even though we have different hobbies. |
| have something in common | 有共同之处；have a lot in common with someone | My cousin and I have a lot in common, including a love of cooking. |
| keep in touch | 保持联系；keep in touch with someone | We keep in touch with our grandparents through calls and voice messages. |
| work something out | 想出解决办法；把安排商量妥当；work out a plan together | We need to work out a plan for the afternoons when both parents are busy. |
| pick somebody up | 去接某人，再带其离开；pick someone up from school | My aunt picks me up from school on Mondays. |
| drop somebody off | 把某人送到某处后离开；drop someone off at a club | Dad will drop us off at the sports centre before he goes to work. |
| make arrangements | 作安排；落实有关事项；make arrangements for childcare | We made arrangements for childcare before we changed our working hours. |
| fit around | 在时间安排上与……相协调；fit around working hours | The club's opening times fit around my mother's working hours. |

### 几个容易混淆的地方

**look after / care about：照料与关心。** I look after my little brother on Saturday mornings. 指周六上午实际照料弟弟，例如陪他待着、准备食物。I care about my brother. 说的是在意他的感受和处境，并没有说明谁负责照料。care for 有时也能表示照料，但日常说清谁照看孩子，用 look after 很直接。

**on your own / lonely：自己做不等于感到孤独。** She can get ready for school on her own. 表示她能自己完成上学前的准备。She feels lonely after moving to a new town. 则说她搬家后感到孤单。独自待一会儿也可能很舒服：I enjoy a little time on my own after a busy day.

**remember / remind：自己记得与提醒别人。** I remembered to collect the form. 是“我记得去取了表格”。My sister reminded me to collect it. 是“姐姐提醒了我”。remind 后要交代提醒谁，再接 to do；不要写 My sister reminded to collect it。如果是“这张照片让我想起爷爷”，用 The photo reminds me of my grandfather. 

**pick up / drop off：接走与送到。** I will pick you up from school. 是去学校接你；I will drop you off at the club. 是把你送到活动地点。人称代词放在短语中间：pick her up、drop them off。用人名时，pick Nora up 和 pick up Nora 都可以。

### 一段可以直接读出来的家庭对话

**Dad:** I have to stay at work a little later on Thursday. Can we work out a different plan?  
**Mum:** I can pick Nora up from the club, but I cannot get there before five.  
**Dad:** That should be fine. The club closes at half past five.  
**Nora:** Will I still have time to visit Grandma?  
**Mum:** Not that evening. We could see her on Saturday instead.  
**Nora:** Could I send her a voice message after dinner?  
**Dad:** Of course. You could tell her about the model you made.  
**Mum:** I will let the club know that I am collecting you this time.  
**Nora:** All right. I will put my club bag by the door tonight.  
**Dad:** Thanks. I will remind you to take your water bottle.

这段对话先说变动，再核对关门时间；孩子问起原来的探望计划，大人给出周六见面、今晚发语音这两个可以落实的办法。I cannot get there before five 是“五点以前到不了”，并不是“五点以后不能去”。I will let the club know... 是“我会通知活动中心……”，let someone know 后面接需要对方知道的消息。Could I...? 在这里是自然提出请求，不表示说话人不知道自己有没有能力发语音。

### 从这些生活内容出发，可以自然地这样说

**We share the household chores, but we also try to leave a little time to talk after dinner.** 我们分担家务，也尽量在饭后留一点聊天时间。这句话同时说到实际分工和相处，不把两者混为一谈。

**My daughter packs her own bag, although I still help her check the timetable when her routine changes.** 女儿平时自己整理书包，但日常安排有变化时，我仍会帮她核对课表。独立与得到帮助可以出现在同一段生活里。

**We do not agree about everything, but we keep in touch and make time for the things we both enjoy.** 我们并非事事看法相同，但会保持联系，也给共同的兴趣留时间。这种说法能具体表达关系亲近，又不需要把家人描写得毫无分歧。
task_prompt:
如果愿意，读完可以回想其中一件小事，不必逐题完成。

- Lena 的妈妈怎样在忙碌的一天里留出相处时间？用中文想清楚，或用一两句英文概括。
- Nora 喜欢舞蹈课，为什么一家人还要查看课表？他们后来找到什么安排？
feedback_md:
**陪伴不一定要等到整天空闲。**

They take a short walk after dinner and take turns talking about their day. Her mother puts her phone away and lets Lena finish her story.

这两句说明了相处发生在什么时候、双方做了什么，以及妈妈怎样认真听。重点是具体行为，不是把“关爱”反复换成不同形容词。

**偏好需要和实际安排接起来。**

The weekday dance class ends before either parent can collect Nora. They find a Saturday class instead, and her father can drop her off on his way to the shops.

原来的困难是接送时间，不是 Nora 不喜欢那门课。周六的安排把活动时间和爸爸的行程接了起来。before either parent can collect her 表示结束时父母两人都还无法来接。
transfer_prompt: 可以想一件自己熟悉的家庭小事：一起做饭、打电话或安排周末见面。若想留一句话，写清“谁在什么时间做什么”，再补一个具体原因即可。例如：We call my grandmother on Sunday afternoons because that is when everyone is usually at home.（我们周日下午给奶奶打电话，因为那时大家通常都在家。）
